answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with progressive proof-of-personhood bonds. Each identity must forge a public history of useful tasks, backed by a timber of independent attestations and a refundable stake. Creating many identities multiplies verification work and locks capital; repeated failures increase the bond geometrically, forcing an attacker's cost into a spiral. Random challenge audits expose fabricated histories, slash dishonest bonds, and make honest participation cheaper than imitation.
